set.body:
Context: eidolon ADR 0001 establishes gale -> scalafim -> eidolon, with eidolon as the sole authority for persisted workflow graphs, operational planning, scheduling, cache/publication state, and run lifecycle. The current open epic bd-01KX6G842E07NN3XZSQF2Z5HH3 predates that boundary and assigns application orchestration to scalafim.

Scope:
- Re-scope the out-of-core fMRI epic around reusable scientific study specifications, compilers, model plans, kernels, and format adapters.
- Keep deterministic scientific work descriptors where they are independently reusable; move FlowDocument lowering, resumable run orchestration, application provenance, cache policy, and publication lifecycle to eidolon.
- Classify each existing child issue as retain, revise, supersede, or move to eidolon, preserving valid scientific acceptance tests.
- Record the intended eidolon dependency in module-relations documentation without introducing a scalafim -> eidolon build dependency.

Acceptance:
- The epic and affected child issues no longer claim application workflow authority for scalafim.
- Retained scalafim APIs are usable independently by CLI, tests, and eidolon adapters.
- Superseded orchestration work is linked to the corresponding eidolon milestone item.

Downstream consumer: eidolon M1.04 bd-01KXYH4NRMFGV41W48AD6N5Y0P.
set.title: RFE: align scalafim workflow scope with eidolon ownership
